name: peekaboo-run
description: Compile Amiga projects with Bartman's tools and debug them in Peekaboo: source-level breakpoints, variables, watches and call stacks.

program.description: Bartman output program, with or without the .exe suffix.

server.description: URL of the running Peekaboo instance.

focus.description: Bring Peekaboo to the foreground after loading the program.

stopOnEntry.description: Halt at the program's entry point so a debugger can attach before any user code runs.

gdbPath.description: Path to m68k-amiga-elf-gdb. Defaults to the copy bundled with Bartman's amiga-debug extension.

gdbPort.description: Port Peekaboo's GDB server listens on (Preferences -> GDB Server).

elfPath.description: ELF carrying debug info. Defaults to the sibling .elf next to the program.

attach.description: Debug whatever Peekaboo is already running instead of sending a new build.

timeout.description: How long to wait for Peekaboo's GDB server, in milliseconds.

loadTimeout.description: How long to wait for the program to finish loading in Peekaboo, in milliseconds.

globalsFilter.description: Only list globals whose name matches this regex, in the Variables pane. Leave unset to list them all.
